title: Chemically pre-lithiated/sodiated reduced graphene oxide–antimony oxide composites for high-rate capability and long-term cycling stability in lithium and sodium-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1998-2013
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00172B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Minseop Lee, Gi-Chan Kim, Seung-Min Paek
This study presents a graphene–antimony dual-function anode material synthesized through a simple chemical pre-lithiation/sodiation process, achieving near-theoretical capacities and outstanding cycling stability.
